details:
Im using my Pico headset with airlink to play via steam vr. And lately in-game i've been having some issues with my controlers, like:

1. After 10 min of its working fine, it just randomly stops, and i cant move normally as i used to, for it to work i need to press down on my thumbstick and hold it like a button.

2. Whenever i open the big menu, next to the microphe button that we see in-game i see that my gestures turn themselves off, and goes back on once i close the menu.

3. My gestures (facial expression) are not working either, hands are stuck in finger guns, and wont change.

I did try to reisntall the game, change the controller bindings in steam vr, or change them in the vrcaht controller settings, but none of it helped.

What i did notice is that, in the state when they were working the controllers are showed in game as quest controllers (and in that state it works fine, so i guess pico controllers that i use, are just the closest once that game know). But when the issue appears after 10 min, it changes to some other once that im not familiar with (And the steam vr option dissapers from the list). I will provide the pictures of it below. At this point, it stops working right away, and i cant move or anything no matter what i click. Vrchat support told me to write about it here.

I am looking forwatd for any help.
title: controller bug
